The '''Kafiri Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], known for its treacherous passages and difficult terrain. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] placed an [[agrocite processing facility]] in the mountains under the stewardship of the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]], who protected it with a [[weather-control station]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces eventually reached the factory and liberated its [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Khormai workers.
